items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: I think it was Martin Luther King who once said

ctx.x: nice you just couldn't believe it.

You can't believe that it was once the way it was. It's come a long way. I think it was Martin Luther King who once said that the South would come into its own in terms of social progress much faster than the North, because the North was yet trying to pretend as though it didn't exist. Many of the southern states have come head on with the issue.
Yes, in the South they had one common thing they'd always tell us; 'You all come back.'
